answer: Post a bond per identity, held 30 epochs, and split each audit across three auditors who never share a subnet. The unit of trust is a task, so a farm of 1,000 keys locks 1,000 bonds before it grades anything, 500 POA idle per key. A jury reads that task record as its only signal, which makes shale-thin margin accounts drop out early. Still open: who re-prices the bond when karst-grade auditors become scarce?
